relations.subject: Ajahn Amaro
relations.evidence: Ajahn Amaro (born 2 September 1956) is a British–American Theravāda Buddhist monk and teacher, and abbot of the Amaravati Buddhist Monastery at the eastern end of the Chiltern Hills in South East England.

relations.evidence: He was educated at Sutton Valence School and Bedford College, University of London... Having completed his honours degree in psychology and physiology, in 1977 he went to Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand
